Sandra Heart <sandraheart52@gmail.com>                                                            Mon, Oct 19, 2026 at 6:11 PM
To: Sandra Heart <sandraheart52@gmail.com>

 PUBLIC COMMENT
 BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS
 PROJECT NO. 58317: SB 6 IMPLEMENTATION
 TO THE HONORABLE PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS:
 I am writing as a Texas resident, utility ratepayer, and senior citizen regarding Project No. 58317. My goal is not to oppose
 the development of data centers in our state, but to urge the Commission to protect vulnerable consumers from absorbing
 the massive infrastructure costs required to support them.
 Specifically, the rising delivery fees on my monthly electricity bills are becoming a severe financial burden. As a senior
 citizen living on a fixed income, I cannot afford to see my delivery fees continuously increase to pay for the massive power
 lines and grid upgrades that large-scale data centers require to operate.
 These data centers must completely fund their own grid integrations, interconnection costs, and dedicated infrastructure.
 Texas families and seniors should not be asked to subsidize the immense infrastructure demands of private data center
 corporations through inflated delivery charges. I urge the Commission to establish strict cost-allocation rules that require
 these data center developers to pay for 100% of their own grid impact, ensuring that Texas residents are fully insulated
 from these unfair fee increases.
 Respectfully submitted,
 Name: Sandra Heart
 City/County: Hurst / Tarrant County
 Date: October 19, 2026
